parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Require both canonical_smiles and pubmed_id_or_doi to be present. Use the join path molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary to acquire publication provenance. Use INNER JOIN compound_structures to enforce the SMILES requirement. Filter by target CHEMBL3717 and standard_type IC50. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
